from openpyxl import Workbook

workbook = Workbook()
worksheet = workbook.active
worksheet.title = "Values"

worksheet.append(["Email", "Value"])
worksheet.append(["alice@example.com", "Test Value"])

workbook.save("email_value.xlsx")
print("Created email_value.xlsx")
